hero.eyebrow: Maker by trade. Steady by practice.
hero.intro: Interfaces forged with care. Old code put to rights. Work that holds when the easy fixes fail.

art.label: An illustrated island, stone observatory and celestial chart
art.alt: An engraved island with a stone observatory, winding river and celestial compass.
art.caption: A quiet outpost. Plenty left to build.

about.label: Tools of the trade
about.body: I’ve tended long-lived React codebases and raised products from bare ground. I trace the trouble, mend what’s brittle, and leave the next engineer a clearer path.

springworks.summary: Tending product frontends, renewing old code, and guiding newer hands. React, TypeScript, and tests that stand watch.

techwarelab.summary: Built web and mobile interfaces from the ground up. React, Angular, and Ionic were the tools of the trade.

kadha.description: A ledger for your films and shows. Yours to keep, beyond the reach of prying eyes.

worlds.description: An arcade shooter for restless hands. Hold your ground, dodge the fire, and see how long you last.

ascii.description: A looking glass that draws in characters. Your webcam, turned to ASCII.

genre.description: Find the genre behind a tune. No toll at the gate.
